title: Cancel Enrollment – All Lesson Allocations Archived, Not Deleted
description: Gap/update case - Decision Table, contrasts with the legacy-wording baseline (case 1808, "Cancel Enrollment – All LAs and Class Members Deleted") - cancelling an enrollment application archives every Lesson Allocation it created rather than deleting them. All records remain reachable by Id, excluded from active lists, with their Class Member/Student Session children hidden via the Is_Archived__c formula.
preconditions:
- Student A has an enrollment application that created Lesson Allocations for Course A (One-Time) and Course B (Schedule), both with classes auto-assigned and students appearing in their respective lessons' Student Sessions.
- Enable_Lesson_Allocation_Archive__c = TRUE.
steps_actions:
1. "HQ or CM Staff opens the enrollment application detail and clicks "Cancel Enrollment""
2. "HQ or CM Staff opens Student A's Course A and Course B Lesson Allocations directly by record Id"
3. "HQ or CM Staff navigates to Student A's Course tab / Lesson Allocation list"
4. "HQ or CM Staff opens the Course A and Course B lessons Student A was assigned to"
steps_result:
1. "The enrollment is cancelled"
2. "Both Lesson Allocations still exist and are reachable; both show Archived_At__c populated"
3. "Neither Lesson Allocation appears in the active list"
4. "Student A is removed from both lessons' Student Sessions - same end-user-visible outcome as the legacy "deleted" baseline (case 1808)"
steps_data:
1. "Enrollment status = Cancelled"
2. "Archived_At__c = current timestamp on both; neither record deleted"
3. "Both excluded from active-list queries (Archived_At__c = NULL filter)"
4. "Both Student Sessions' Is_Archived__c = TRUE (via formula) -> hidden, not deleted"
